story_type: bomb squad controlled detonation of a stack of blasting caps at sunset
hook: A bomb squad set off a stack of blasting caps at sunset.
narration: This is an Air Force bomb squad setting off a stack of blasting caps.
The crew drove out on Ali Al Salem Air Base, Kuwait, with cans marked explosive.
Each red cap is a detonator, built to set off bigger charges.
They packed the caps tight, taped them down, and pulled back as the sun went down.
outcome: The EOD flight finished its controlled detonation in a burst of sparks.

location_card.place: Ali Al Salem Air Base, Kuwait

title: Blasting caps blown up at sunset
description:
The 386th Expeditionary Civil Engineer Squadron Explosive Ordnance Disposal flight completes a controlled detonation at Ali Al Salem Air Base, Kuwait, April 2, 2021.
